verification.population_scope: exported DII and four photoevent channels; no full 13-species export
exported DII and four photoevent channels; no full 13-species export

ledger_normalization.energy: max magnitude of actual, expected, and initial total gas+radiation energy

native.decision: Two time-by-birth interactions measured. Mean age and q2 are sensitive to birth refinement; universal second order and native distribution convergence are not demonstrated.

frozen_scalar.thick_scope: AP tested through tau1e12; five parent fitted-rule calls at tau1e300 return NoForwardProgress and are classified as representation limits.

frozen_source.distance_scope: Mixture CDF/W1 upper bounds from retained label certificates plus label-weight TV; not exact unlabelled mixture distances.

scalar.method: Decimal90 on exact round-tripped f64 nodes; analytic quantile-antiderivative route independent of Rust positive CDF plateau integrals.
scalar.exponential_tail_policy: exp(-z) replaced by zero for z>1800; for this unit-weight matrix normalized omitted mass <=1e12*exp(-1800)<2e-770.
scalar.certificate_scope: Floating numerical verification of real-arithmetic identities, not an outward-rounded interval proof or evolving-gas error bound.

source.actual_node_sample_selection: Predeclared smallest and largest total opacity in each of AP r1,r2,r4,r8 and GL2,GL4; ties select smallest rule_id.
source.composition_scope: All 4608 label rows are checked for source identity and independently recombined. Their per-label certificate values are input to this arithmetic check; direct Decimal node integration covers the 12 selected rules only.
source.mixture_scope: Weighted component distances plus label-weight TV are upper bounds for scalar mixtures, not exact scalar-mixture distances.

edges.edge_input_contract: One atom at age 1/2 for zero opacity, age 1 for absolute underflow, age 0 and exact f64 1e-300 at tau=exact f64 1e300; empty/invalid inputs as named in the Rust example.
edges.reference: Closed single-atom CDF/W1 limits and exact normalized exponential moments; finite upper-tail correction at tau=1e300 is negligible beyond Decimal90, not a changed source model.
edges.zero_source: Physical mass zero; normalized shape undefined.
edges.underflow: A positive analytic survival mass may be unrepresentable in binary64 while its conditional shape remains defined by log-scaled weights.
edges.failure_class: Existing AP rule cannot progress at tau=1e300; NUMERICAL_REPRESENTATION_LIMIT, neither Cx(WorkLimit) nor physical no-solution.

scope_limits: Frozen density/opacity reference does not bound evolving gas response without additional stability estimates.
Native output contains age moments and energy-weighted q2, not full age-energy-angle joint distributions.
Formal finite-difference orders are observational ratios, not an established asymptotic error model.
Source, spectral, angular, threshold and two-way Einstein obligations remain open.
